before_after_note: Keep the prompts, the choice of single prompts or conversation, test data, signed-in identity and model settings the same except for the documented fix; start a fresh chat for each prompt or conversation. Retain actual replies and write your own fix description in the Checklist D response template. Errors, missing setup and a low judge score are not proof of a fix. If no failure is found, record that outcome or follow the honest 'before' note.
honest_before_note: If your bot already defends against a probe, keep a switch or saved version without that defence, for example retrieval off, the previous system prompt, the guardrail disabled or the older source document. Run the 'before' test on that version, then the 'after' test with the defence on, and say so in your fix description. Never edit or invent a reply.
rules_of_engagement: Test only your own group's bot, or the bot assigned to you in a red-teaming round, at the address its owning group gives you. Never point PyRIT-Bench at public or commercial chatbots or websites. Use only the invented test data in these packs: no real personal data, real keys or the confidential Appendix B formula.
